title: Hunts FH-027: Run single-business pilot

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 2, Pilot. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Train staff, inspect signage and test closure, lost connection, duplicate redemption and consent withdrawal. Done when: Field report proves staffed finish and merchant-only opt-ins with no stock discrepancies. Requires: FH-022, FH-024, FH-026. Owner role: Operations and QA.
